label: seide
title: せいで
meaning: because of, due to (indicates only negative meaning) he died because~, he lost his fortune because~,...
meaning_example: Due to lack of sleep, I have a headache today

notes.text: せいで;のせいだ;せいで;せいか
notes.html: せいで;のせいだ;せいで;せいか

notes.text: 所為　(せい)	(n) cause/ reason/ fault (from WWWJDIC) Using the Kanji in this grammatical construction is likely very rare, however.
notes.html: 所為　(せい)	(n) cause/ reason/ fault (from WWWJDIC) Using the Kanji in this grammatical construction is likely very rare, however.
